paragraphs: Isi ben Akavya, [Pesachim 113b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.113b.18). Chananya ben Akavya, [Eruvin 86b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.86b.14).[^1]

notes.text: Pesachim gives Isi ben Akavya at the end of a list of his alternate names. The consulted Eruvin writes Rabbi Chananya ben Akavya with a final aleph (עקביא). [Heilprin’s Chananya entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1517&lang=en) cites the Eruvin passage. The two attestations do not establish a shared father.
